summary: OpenAI describes a research collaboration in which researchers used one of its reasoning models to help physicians diagnose rare childhood genetic diseases, identifying 18 new diagnoses in previously unsolved cases.

categories.reason: The model was used directly in a clinical diagnostic workflow to identify new disease diagnoses for patients.
categories.quote: Researchers used an OpenAI reasoning model to help diagnose rare diseases, identifying 18 new diagnoses in previously unsolved cases.

practices.reason: The reported outcome is a real-world case study of diagnostic accuracy rather than a transferable benchmark or method an engineering team could run.
